aliases: customer asks for a human to confirm completed work after earlier requests
customer demands a supervisor after blocked closures

when.quote: When using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, select the most accurate reason code from the tiered list below.

starts.note: customer: only when the customer asks for a human or supervisor, or agrees to one the agent proposes because the issue cannot be resolved. Never transfer without asking the customer first. Scenario-specific transfer protocols in other jobs (incident or decline protocols) override this job.
starts.quote: Do not transfer without asking the user first.

info.about: That the customer wants a human or supervisor, and why (frustration, service complaint, an offer the agent cannot give, the closure itself, confirmation of completed work)
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent?

info.about: How many times in this conversation the customer has asked for a human

steps.do: Keep one count of the customer's requests for a human across the whole conversation, from the opening message on, including requests made before verification or during other jobs. Each new request adds 1; the count is never reset when the topic changes.
steps.if: the customer asks for a human agent
steps.quote: If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool.

steps.do: If the customer asks for a human while something they want is still within your tools and documents, say politely that you can help with it and keep helping. Count each request for a human.
steps.if: the customer asks for a human agent and a request you can act on remains open
steps.quote: If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first.

steps.do: Transfer when either: nothing the customer asked for remains that you can act on (every card is closed, kept with an offer, or blocked by a requirement you cannot resolve) and the customer confirms they want the transfer; or the customer has asked for a human 4 times.
steps.if: the customer asked for a human agent or supervisor
steps.quote: If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool.

steps.do: Pick the reason code from the highest tier that applies. Tier 1: customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal when the customer kept demanding an offer that is not available (for example a larger retention credit) and now demands a human; account_closure_request when the customer wants a human to close an account. Tier 3 only if no Tier 1/2 code fits: supervisor_request_service_complaint (unhappy with service quality) or customer_frustrated_demands_human (general frustration).
steps.quote: Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

steps.do: If every request was completed successfully in this conversation and the customer wants a human only to confirm the work or ask follow-up questions, and no Tier 1 or Tier 2 case still needs specialist handling, use reason request_completed_customer_wants_human_followup.
steps.if: decide_transfer allows the transfer, all requested work is done, and the customer wants a human to confirm it
steps.quote: Agent completed the request successfully, but customer wants human for additional questions or confirmation

steps.do: Transfer the customer with a summary of what was done for each item (cards closed, credits applied, payments made) and what remains blocked and why.

args.summary: per item: what was completed and what is blocked, with the requirement
args.reason: the code chosen in pick_reason or pick_reason_followup

steps.if: the customer requested or agreed to the transfer and decide_transfer allows it
steps.quote: When using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, select the most accurate reason code from the tiered list below.

rules.rule: Use account_closure_request when the customer is explicitly asking to close their account
rules.quote: Customer is explicitly requesting to close their account

rules.rule: Use customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal when the customer persisted in demanding an offer that does not exist and now demands a human
rules.quote: Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human

rules.rule: supervisor_request_service_complaint is Tier 3: only when no higher-tier code applies
rules.quote: Customer wants supervisor due to dissatisfaction with service quality (agent was rude, slow, unhelpful manner)
Customer is frustrated and demands human, frustration is general

rules.rule: When nothing can be resolved, ask before transferring
rules.quote: Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent.

rules.rule: Requests for a human are counted across the whole conversation; on the 4th request the agent transfers
rules.quote: If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool.

rules.rule: Use request_completed_customer_wants_human_followup when the work is done and the customer wants a human to confirm it
rules.quote: Agent completed the request successfully, but customer wants human for additional questions or confirmation

done_when: The customer was transferred with a reason code from the highest applicable tier and a per-item summary, or chose to stay with the agent. Requests were counted across the whole conversation, and the transfer happened no later than the 4th request.
